verdict.rationale: Replit documents an official Replit MCP Server that lets a compatible client create, find, inspect, or update Replit Apps (replit-docs-42). That is a real programmatic route to generating and managing apps, but the probe found no published OpenAPI/REST spec (replit-docs-2 probe), and the MCP server rests on a single brief doc mention. Missing for 10: a documented REST/platform API with spec, programmatic deploy/publish control, auth/token details for API access, independent or hands-on corroboration.
